projects.squarex.description: SquareX One is a residential development by Tasmeer Indigo Properties in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. It offers studios and 1- to 2-bedroom apartments, with a study or maid’s room depending on the layout.
projects.squarex.payment: Communicated payment plan: a 5% down payment followed by 95 monthly instalments of 1%. The first 1% payment, due in the current month, is one of these 95 instalments, leaving 94 monthly payments of 1%. An additional 4% DLD fee is announced. Terms and schedule must be confirmed with the agency.
projects.squarex.delivery: Communicated expected handover: Q4 2028, subject to confirmation with the agency.
projects.squarex.marketing: Announced marketing price · availability to be confirmed
projects.squarex.homes: 205 homes and 2 ground-floor retail units announced
projects.squarex.water: Announced shared amenities: adult and children’s pools, lazy river and jacuzzi
projects.squarex.wellness: Yoga, relaxation areas, cold plunge, infrared sauna and steam room announced
projects.squarex.sport: Outdoor gym, padel and clubhouse announced
projects.squarex.inventory: The prices above are starting marketing prices, distinct from the precise prices in the 11 November inventory. That document lists units marked available and sold at the time of issue; it is not current stock. It does not confirm any available studios.
projects.shione.description: SHIONE, announced by BEYOND, is within SIØRA on Island B, Dubai Islands. Its Japanese-inspired architecture offers apartments and duplexes with terraces in a waterfront setting.
projects.shione.payment: An announced 50/50 payment plan and AED 50,000 EOI are subject to confirmation against the applicable price list. EOI refund terms have not been established. Contact the agency for current prices.
projects.shione.delivery: Announced expected handover: Q4 2030, subject to confirmation with the agency.
projects.shione.types: Apartments and duplexes; private terraces depending on the property type
projects.shione.water: Water views announced, with some 270° views depending on the home; no view is guaranteed for an unidentified unit
projects.shione.pool: Announced 812 m² resort-style shared pool; scope and access to be confirmed
projects.shione.prices: Property types describe the development. Prices, areas, views, amenities and availability of individual homes must be confirmed with the agency.
